Container.Name: Crossfade
Container.DonateText: Like Crossfade? Buy me a coffee.
Container.Overview: Keeps liked songs, libraries and playlists in sync across music streaming services: one way, both ways or in groups. Supported services: see the README.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI (put your reverse proxy, e.g. Nginx Proxy Manager, in front of it).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, encrypted logins and automatic backups (backups/).

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: HTTPS address where Crossfade is reachable through your reverse proxy (no trailing /). Needed for service sign-ins that redirect back to Crossfade.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored logins. Generate once (at least 32 characters), keep it safe, NEVER change it.

Config.Name: Spotify Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, can also be entered in the app under Account → App credentials.

Config.Name: Google Client ID
Config.Description: Optional, for YouTube Music sign-in with a Google code.

Config.Name: Parallel syncs
Config.Description: How many fades may sync at the same time (always one per person).
